name: Signature Series Biceps Curl (SPLBC)
source: Two orthographic side-view poses (start and finish) from the official Life Fitness SPLBC Owner's Manual placard, cross-checked against the exploded weldments diagram (manual page 3) and the manufacturer demonstration video (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fuMn3ukena4&t=52s). The belt-cam model gives 0.55 kgf/kg at start rising smoothly to 0.79 kgf/kg at finish (stroke mean 0.67 kgf/kg, agreeing closely with the 0.68 kgf/kg independent video work ratio) for combined tangential handle force across the shared workarm.

base_resistance.source: Life Fitness lists 5 kg starting resistance per workarm. Applied once to the shared workarm and held constant across the stroke by default.

observation.evidence: Orthographic side-view start (panel 1) and finish (panel 2) diagrams from the official Life Fitness Signature Series Plate-Loaded Biceps Curl (SPLBC) Owner's Manual placard, cross-checked with the exploded frame weldments diagram (manual page 3) confirming a lower weight-arm pivot (item 2), upper cam/workarm assembly (items 3 and 5), and a single taut belt connecting the weight arm to the cam. Two placard poses establish a smooth monotonic cam profile without the quantization jump caused by low-res oblique video intervals.
